profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Going
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with experience in Ruby on Rails, React.js, JavaScript, Redux, jQuery, and HTML5. As a software engineer with a background in accounting, I enjoy looking at the details and piecing together code to develop something great for users. When I'm not coding, I am out trying new restaurants with my foodstagram friends or binging Netflix.

positions.title: Staff Accountant II
positions.description:
• Performed monthly reconciliation and analysis on balance sheet accounts to ensure that the general ledger and the books tie out.
• Managed accounts of Rehab business unit through analysis of monthly balance sheet and income statement. Worked to create a streamlined financial package to lead monthly meetings with fiscal leader.
• Assisted in the implementation of the new ERP (Workday) system by building Workday reports to be utilized by all 4 major hospital teams.
• Reorganized internal lease management files, increasing ease and efficiency of lease yearly budget planning.

positions.title: Account Executive
positions.description:
• Managed the loan servicing for a portfolio consisting of more than $500 million in commercial real estate, security, and asset-based healthcare lending through daily financial operations.
• Maintained borrower accounts by processing transactions and issuing monthly invoice statements to account for interest, fees, and loan amortization payments.
• Prepared and audited client financial statements to verify availability for each draw advance and to ensure compliance with loan agreements as well as federal regulations.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description:
• Assisted the faculty and supervisors in daily clerical tasks.
• Scanned and filed documents through computer system, Optix and BA3.
